topic: Instantaneous Rate of Change and the Derivative

sections.title: The Hook: From Average to Instantaneous
lecture_lines: How fast is the cheetah at exactly 2s?
Shrink the time interval toward zero to see.
animations: Display cheetah icon at origin and draw distance marker for 100m. Color: #FF4500.
Show a clock set to 2s, highlight position at 2s with a dot. Color: #00BFFF.
Animate interval shrinking towards 2s, showing average velocity converging to instantaneous. Color: #32CD32.

sections.title: Visualizing the Secant Line
lecture_lines: A secant line shows average rate of change.
As point B slides to A, slope changes.
The secant line becomes the tangent line.
animations: Plot curve f(x) and draw secant line through A and B. Color: #FFD700.
Animate point B moving closer to A along the curve. Color: #FF8C00.
Morph secant line into tangent line at A as B converges to A. Color: #FF4500.

sections.title: The Mathematical Definition
lecture_lines: Rise is f(x+h)-f(x), Run is h.
As h shrinks, average rate becomes instantaneous.
This is our mathematical tool for change.
animations: Display limit definition text clearly on screen. Color: #FFFFFF.
Label rise as [f(x+h)-f(x)] and run as h on a right triangle. Color: #00CED1.
Animate shrinking h, show triangle size decreasing. Color: #FF6347.
Show x^2 curve and its tangent slope at 2x. Color: #FFFF00.
Highlight the derivative formula box to emphasize its utility. Color: #7FFF00.

sections.title: Practical Application: Motion Tracking
lecture_lines: Cheetah position s(t) derivative is velocity s'(t).
Derivative is the rate at a specific moment.
Real-time speedometer shows this instantaneous rate.
animations: Show position function s(t) on graph, label derivative s'(t). Color: #FFA500.
Highlight slope at a specific time t=2s on the curve. Color: #FF1493.
Display a speedometer visual needle pointing at the instantaneous rate. Color: #00FF00.

sections.title: Summary and Conclusion
lecture_lines: Turns global curve data into local slope.
Position to velocity: derivative is the key.
animations: Show global curve, draw multiple small tangent lines along it. Color: #8A2BE2.
Animate conversion from curve points to local slope values. Color: #FFD700.
Zoom in on position graph, reveal velocity derivative graph. Color: #00FFFF.
